paragraphs: Abba Shaul, kneader of Rabbi's household.

As stated explicitly in [Pesachim 34a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.34a.1). Perhaps the wording in [Niddah 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.38a.6), “Abba Shaul in the name of Rav,” should read “in the name of Rabbi,” and this is Abba Shaul, Rabbi's kneader.[^1]

notes.text: Pesachim explicitly identifies the kneader of Rabbi’s household. The consulted Niddah says that Abba Shaul spoke in the name of Rav. Hyman suggests reading Rabbi there and identifying the two notices.
